mdac.title: Digital Arrival Card (MDAC)
mdac.description: A mandatory government step for every traveler to Malaysia — separate from a visa and required even when visa-exempt. Skipping it causes airport delays.
mdac.need_arrival: Enter your arrival date and flight number above first, so we open this step at the right time.
mdac.dont_early: ⚠️ Don't submit yet — the government portal only accepts it within 3 days before arrival and rejects earlier submissions. We'll remind you when the window opens.
mdac.scam_warning: ⚠️ Submission is completely free on the official portal only. Any site charging a fee is a scam.
mdac.after_submit: After submitting you'll get a QR code and reference. Enter it here (optional) to save it:
mdac.completed: Submitted. Keep the QR code on your phone for the airport.
mdac.saved: Arrival card status saved. Safe travels!
